programme.title: Shi Jin the Nine-Tattooed Hero: Conquering Waguan Temple

programme.title: Five Young Players

programme.title: Taste of the Guava
programme.desc: A mother and daughter who came from the city encounter another family who came from the village.

programme.title: Li Mingrui

programme.title: Strangers
programme.desc: Two strangers meet on a London-bound train and decide to help one another by killing each other's wives.

programme.title: Nalan the Guard

programme.title: Young Master's Marriages

programme.title: Heroic Shadows of Chang'an: The Mystery of Heavenly Retribution
Phenix Piano
programme.desc: The film shows the touching story of village teachers and their experiences.

programme.title: Martial Arts Squad
programme.desc: Wu Jie from the provincial Wushu team turns down retention offers and returns to his hometown as a Wushu coach. On his way to take office by bus, he subdues violent thieves, rescues the female driver and protects passengers' property from loss.

programme.title: Deep Love

programme.title: A Chinese Odyssey II -- Cinderella
